name: Auphonic
tagline: Auphonic is an AI-powered audio post-processing service that automatically normalises loudness, removes noise, balances multiple speakers, and adds chapter markers to audio files. Podcasters, radio producers, and video creators use it to deliver broadcast-quality audio without manual mixing.
